figurative_meaning_bn: সমার্থক যুগ্মশব্দ; চড়ের পর চড়; হাতের চাপড়
figurative_meaning_en: Synonymous compound word; repeated slaps; hand slaps indicating a physical scuffle or fight
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই দলের মধ্যে খুব চড়চাপড় চলছে।
বাজারে দুই ব্যবসায়ীর মধ্যে চড়চাপাটি শুরু হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There's a lot of slapping going on between the two groups.
A slap fight has broken out between the two shopkeepers in the market.
note: This idiom vividly captures the intensity of physical confrontations in everyday Bengali speech, often used to describe chaotic fights.
